main_text.p: Gtõ ἑ, Ion. ἕο εἵο, Attice ἑοῦεν ἕθεν. Sui.

page.notes: The Greek forms are transcribed as far as legible; several accents and breathings in the small type are doubtful. The marginal glosses are set in a faded italic hand and are only approximately read. The running head and heading lines are reproduced from the scan.
